population: The 283 original reviewed candidate collections in data/claims/review_population.csv; directory-only and rejected candidates are not claimants.

reviewed_collections.definition: Distinct original reviewed candidate collections; every saved candidate quote was read against raw evidence.

reviewed_quote_rows.definition: All original quote rows for that population plus explicitly identified recovered quotes from the same raw evidence; casing duplicates remain visible.

valid_quote_rows.definition: Quote rows accepted under the strict project-authorship and art/metadata storage rule.

claimants.definition: Distinct reviewed collections with at least one accepted project-authored art/metadata storage statement.

excluded_collections.definition: Reviewed candidate collections with no accepted project-authored storage statement.

explicit_100_fully_claimants.definition: Reviewed claimants whose selected strongest accepted quote explicitly says 100%, fully, entirely or completely on-chain; storage-forever alone is excluded.

claimants_repointable_one_account.definition: A live, effective URI-string setter, renderer/descriptor address swap, or upgrade on the ordinary token metadata/art path, controlled by one EOA or one multisig account. Data-only edits are excluded. A multisig account may require several signatures; this does not mean one private key.

claimants_repointable_eoa.definition: Same live-pointer definition, restricted to EOA control.

claimants_repointable_multisig.definition: Same live-pointer definition, restricted to one multisig account.

explicit_repointable_one_account.definition: A live, effective URI-string setter, renderer/descriptor address swap, or upgrade on the ordinary token metadata/art path, controlled by one EOA or one multisig account. Data-only edits are excluded. A multisig account may require several signatures; this does not mean one private key. Restricted to the explicit subset.

explicit_repointable_eoa.definition: Explicit subset with live pointer control by an EOA.

explicit_repointable_multisig.definition: Explicit subset with live pointer control by one multisig account.

claimants_data_mutable_only.definition: Reviewed claimants classed EOA/multisig mutable but lacking live EOA/multisig pointer power; data-only edits are not repointing.

explicit_data_mutable_only.definition: Same data-only definition, restricted to the explicit subset.

contradicted_claims.definition: Saved evidence establishes that the selected project statement is false as stated, accounting for alternate data paths and its scope. Only this outcome may be called a failed claim.

explicit_contradicted_claims.definition: Saved evidence establishes that the selected project statement is false as stated, accounting for alternate data paths and its scope. Only this outcome may be called a failed claim. Restricted to the explicit subset.

mutation_audit_contracts.definition: Historical 606-contract mutation audit population retained to make before/after comparisons coherent; it is not the claimant denominator.

audit_repointable_eoa.definition: The publication definition for repointable by a single EOA: live effective pointer power, including in-path dependencies and upgrades; excludes data-only changes.

audit_repointable_multisig.definition: Historical mutation-audit contracts with live pointer power held by a multisig account.

audit_broad_eoa_mutable.definition: Diagnostic broad class: some EOA-controlled effective mutation path, including data-only edits. Must not be labelled repointable.

audit_broad_eoa_without_pointer.definition: Difference between the broad EOA mutation class and the narrower live-pointer EOA definition.

claimants_in_census.definition: Reviewed claimants with a completed census collection row; denominator for the ordinary-pointer funnel.

claimants_outside_census.definition: Reviewed claimants without a completed census row; scored separately with additional saved reads where available.

outcome_holds.definition: The selected project statement is supported for its stated art/metadata scope by the sampled saved evidence. This does not imply immutable control, successful browser rendering, or exhaustive collection coverage.

explicit_outcome_holds.definition: The selected project statement is supported for its stated art/metadata scope by the sampled saved evidence. This does not imply immutable control, successful browser rendering, or exhaustive collection coverage. Explicit subset only.

outcome_onchain-data-offchain-pointer.definition: Art/data bytes or creative code are evidenced on Ethereum, while ordinary tokenURI or a marketplace media/preview field points off-chain. This supports a data-storage claim and is not a false claim.

explicit_outcome_onchain-data-offchain-p.definition: Art/data bytes or creative code are evidenced on Ethereum, while ordinary tokenURI or a marketplace media/preview field points off-chain. This supports a data-storage claim and is not a false claim. Explicit subset only.

outcome_contradicted.definition: Saved evidence establishes that the selected project statement is false as stated, accounting for alternate data paths and its scope. Only this outcome may be called a failed claim.

explicit_outcome_contradicted.definition: Saved evidence establishes that the selected project statement is false as stated, accounting for alternate data paths and its scope. Only this outcome may be called a failed claim. Explicit subset only.

outcome_unverifiable.definition: The scoped statement is not resolved by available reads, incomplete coverage, gas limits or ambiguous wording; neither true nor false is asserted.

explicit_outcome_unverifiable.definition: The scoped statement is not resolved by available reads, incomplete coverage, gas limits or ambiguous wording; neither true nor false is asserted. Explicit subset only.

outcome_definitions.holds: The selected project statement is supported for its stated art/metadata scope by the sampled saved evidence. This does not imply immutable control, successful browser rendering, or exhaustive collection coverage.
outcome_definitions.onchain-data-offchain-pointer: Art/data bytes or creative code are evidenced on Ethereum, while ordinary tokenURI or a marketplace media/preview field points off-chain. This supports a data-storage claim and is not a false claim.
outcome_definitions.contradicted: Saved evidence establishes that the selected project statement is false as stated, accounting for alternate data paths and its scope. Only this outcome may be called a failed claim.
outcome_definitions.unverifiable: The scoped statement is not resolved by available reads, incomplete coverage, gas limits or ambiguous wording; neither true nor false is asserted.

funnel_definitions.claimants: Reviewed claimants present in the census; excludes reviewed claimants outside the census.
funnel_definitions.a_tokenURI_onchain: Ordinary tokenURI/uri returned on-chain metadata in the census.
funnel_definitions.b_media_also_onchain: Stage a plus census onchain_candidate (metadata and sampled media on-chain).
funnel_definitions.c_renders_unplugged_clean: Legacy key: census onchain_candidate_clean, additionally excluding observed gallery test unplugged failures where tested. This is a candidate count; only c_of_which_render_tested_w4 was browser tested.
funnel_definitions.c_of_which_render_tested_w4: Stage c collections actually covered by gallery test, not all candidates.
funnel_definitions.d_also_immutable: Stage c plus mutation audit class_final immutable. This concerns current known mutation paths, not historical immutability.
funnel_definitions.failed_at: Legacy schema key for exclusion at pointer-funnel stages; these are NOT false-claim counts.
funnel_definitions.known_mutation_path: Stage c collections with a known non-immutable mutation audit class; includes data-only edits and is not the repointable count.
funnel_definitions.live_pointer_power: Stage c split by the narrow pointer_power measure: EOA, multisig, DAO/timelock, or none; matches the repointable definition.
funnel_definitions.denominator: Each prop stores k/n, percentage and 95% Wilson interval; n is the full subgroup, not its previous stage.

funnel.definition: Manually reviewed project-authored claims only; funnel stages concern ordinary tokenURI resolution, not truth of alternate-data storage claims.
